questions.question: The rate of oil is increased by 12% every year. The rate in the next year would be ₹125.44 per litre. What is the difference between the prices (in ₹) per litre of the oil in the last year and this year?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of oil this year = ₹125.44 per litre.

Rate of oil increases by 12% every year.

**Formula Used:**

Rate of oil last year = Rate of oil this year / (1 + Increase Rate).

Difference in rates = Rate of oil this year - Rate of oil last year.

**Calculation:**

Rate of oil this year = ₹125.44 / (1 + 12/100)

⇒ ₹125.44 / 1.12

⇒ ₹112.00

Rate of oil last year = ₹112 / (1 + 12/100)

⇒ ₹112 / 1.12

⇒ ₹100

Difference in rates = ₹112 - ₹100

⇒ ₹12

**The difference between the prices per litre of the oil in the last year and this year is ₹12.**

questions.question: A, B and C start running around a circular track and complete one round in 16, 20 and 28 seconds, respectively. In how much time will they meet again at the starting point?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete one round = 16 seconds

Time taken by B to complete one round = 20 seconds

Time taken by C to complete one round = 28 seconds

**Formula Used:**

To find the time when A, B, and C meet again at the starting point, calculate the LCM (Least Common Multiple) of their times.

**Calculation:**

Find the LCM of 16, 20, and 28:

Prime factorization:

16 = 2⁴

20 = 2² × 5

28 = 2² × 7

LCM = Highest powers of all prime factors

LCM = 2⁴ × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM = 16 × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM = 560 seconds

**They will meet again at the starting point after 560 seconds.**

questions.question: A cylinder has a total surface area of 2112 cm². Find the radius of the cylinder if its curved surface area is (5)/(12) of total surface area. (Use pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total surface area of the cylinder = 2112 cm²

Curved surface area = (5/12) × Total surface area

Use π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Total surface area of a cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

Curved surface area = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

Curved surface area = (5/12) × 2112

⇒ Curved surface area = 880 cm²

Curved surface area = 2πrh

⇒ 880 = 2 × (22/7) × r × h

⇒ 880 = (44/7) × r × h

⇒ r × h = (880 × 7) / 44

⇒ r × h = 140

Total surface area = 2πr(h + r)

⇒ 2112 = 2 × (22/7) × r × (h + r)

⇒ 2112 = (44/7) × r × (h + r)

⇒ r × (h + r) = (2112 × 7) / 44

⇒ r × (h + r) = 336

From r × h = 140 and r × (h + r) = 336:

h + r = 336 / r

Substitute h = 140 / r into h + r = 336 / r:

⇒ (140 / r) + r = 336 / r

⇒ 140 + r² = 336

⇒ r² = 336 - 140

⇒ r² = 196

⇒ r = √196

⇒ r = 14 cm

**The radius of the cylinder is 14 cm.**

questions.question: The average of 5 consecutive natural numbers is 7. Which is the largest number among these?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 5 consecutive natural numbers = 7.

**Formula Used:**

If the average of n consecutive numbers is given, the numbers are: (Average - (n-1)/2), (Average - (n-1)/2 + 1), ..., (Average + (n-1)/2).

**Calculation:**

Number of terms (n) = 5.

Average = 7.

Consecutive numbers formula: (7 - (5-1)/2), (7 - (5-1)/2 + 1), ..., (7 + (5-1)/2).

⇒ Numbers = (7 - 2), (7 - 2 + 1), (7 - 2 + 2), (7 - 2 + 3), (7 - 2 + 4).

⇒ Numbers = 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.

Largest number = 9.

**The largest number among these is 9.**

questions.question: A thief saw a policeman from a distance of 300 m and started running. At the same time, the policeman started chasing the thief. If the speed of the thief is 12 km/h and that of the policeman 15 km/h, then the distance (in km) covered by the policeman to catch the thief is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between thief and policeman = 300 m = 0.3 km

Speed of the thief = 12 km/h

Speed of the policeman = 15 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed = Speed of policeman - Speed of thief

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

Distance covered by policeman = Speed of policeman × Time

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed = 15 - 12 = 3 km/h

Time taken to catch the thief = Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 0.3 / 3

⇒ Time = 0.1 hours

Distance covered by the policeman = Speed of policeman × Time

⇒ Distance = 15 × 0.1

⇒ Distance = 1.5 km

**The distance covered by the policeman to catch the thief is 1.5 km.**

questions.question: There are 20 cricket balls in the showroom. Among these 20 balls, some are yellow and some are white. The average cost of all the balls is ₹75. If the average cost of yellow balls is ₹80 and that of white is ₹60, then the number of yellow balls is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total balls = 20

Average cost of all = ₹75

Average cost of yellow = ₹80

Average cost of white = ₹60

Calculations:

Let number of yellow balls = x ⇒ white balls = 20 − x

Total cost = (x × 80) + ((20 − x) × 60)

Average = Total cost ÷ 20 = 75

⇒ (80x + 60(20 − x)) ÷ 20 = 75

⇒ (80x + 1200 − 60x) ÷ 20 = 75

⇒ (20x + 1200) ÷ 20 = 75

⇒ 20x + 1200 = 1500

⇒ 20x = 300 ⇒ x = 15

**∴ Number of yellow balls = 15**

questions.question: Find the gain percentage, given that Siddhi sold her scooter for ₹28935 gaining (1)/(5)th of the selling price.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹28935

Gain = (1/5) of the Selling Price

**Formula Used:**

Gain % = (Gain / Cost Price) × 100

Cost Price (CP) = SP - Gain

**Calculation:**

Gain = (1/5) × SP

⇒ Gain = (1/5) × 28935

⇒ Gain = 5787

Cost Price (CP) = SP - Gain

⇒ CP = 28935 - 5787

⇒ CP = 23148

Gain % = (Gain / CP) × 100

⇒ Gain % = (5787 / 23148) × 100

⇒ Gain % = 0.25 × 100

⇒ Gain % = 25%

**The gain percentage is 25%.**

The marks obtain by Naveen in Exam-II are what per cent of the total marks obtained by all five students in Exam-II?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Exam-II Marks:

Surya = 90

Kiran = 110

Mukesh = 100

Naveen = 120

Suresh = 60

**Formula used:**

Required % = (Naveen's marks ÷ Total marks of all students) × 100

**Calculations:**

Total = 90 + 110 + 100 + 120 + 60 = 480

⇒ Required % = (120 ÷ 480) × 100 = 25%

**∴ Naveen’s marks in Exam-II are 25% of total Exam-II marks.**
